AII-1000-44647: Huang Jianhao and associates operated a romance scam ring since 2019, using AI voice-cloning technology to impersonate women on dating websites. Male chat operators engaged victims in romantic conversation while AI software converted their voices in real-time into gentle female voices. After building emotional connection, the ring deployed actual female escorts to meet victims and directed them to cooperating beauty salons, tattoo shops and pawnbrokers for a coordinated "strip" operation, with staff charging inflated prices on credit cards. Reported impact Victims were deceived into purchases and money transfers through the coordinated scam operations across multiple businesses. Index analysis The scam exploited the combination of AI-generated female voices and in-person female escorts to deceive victims, with coordinated participation from legitimate businesses in a supply chain. Governance controls Police conducted two waves of searches and arrests of ring members and cooperating vendors. The Taipei District Prosecutors Office obtained detention orders for Huang Jianhao and other members.
